title: Stocks struggling after a day of panic selling
speaker: TheTechnicalTraders host

macro_themes.view: Big inflation numbers shocked markets and drove an all-day panic sell-off that carries into today's gap down.
Panic selling, VIX spike and rising put/call suggest an emotional, oversold move likely to rebound.
Crude holding up keeps inflation a key problem.
Regional banks ~12-13% off highs in a multi-month decline despite strong trading earnings.

calls.condition: If the gap down after panic selling gets bought back up (short-term exhaustion).
calls.reason: Panic selling indicator above 3 all day, VIX and put/call spiking: fear-driven oversold condition likely to rebound.
calls.quote: There's enough fear... that I think that is going to spark could be a short-term exhaustion move. Market gaps down and it gets bought back up

calls.reason: Nasdaq down 1.3% with big tech and semis unwinding; closed QLD long per exit plan and waiting for Nasdaq to reposition.
calls.quote: we did close out our QLD position, and we are now waiting to see how the Nasdaq is going to position itself

calls.reason: Have been expecting yields to fade and bonds to rise; yields dropping sharply this morning.
calls.quote: We've been expecting yields to fade down, the dollar to fade down, for bonds to move higher.

calls.reason: Expects the dollar to fade along with yields; yesterday's spike called temporary.
calls.quote: We've been expecting yields to fade down, the dollar to fade down

notes: Gold/silver/miners bounce described as current moves and 'short-term noise', no forward bias, so not recorded. ES rebound call is hedged ('we never know').
